product.description: Monoprice™20‑Channel Snake & 16 XLR x 4 TRS Stage Box ‑ 100 feet25AWG Conductors and Features 16 Downstream and 4 Upstream ConnectionsConnect your mixing board to your stage performers with this 100 foot 20‑channel XLR/TRS Snake with 16x4 Stage Box from Monoprice™!This professional audio snake uses 25AWG conductors and features 16 downstream and 4 upstream connections. The heavy duty stage box measures 12.6" x 6.9" x 2.9". It has 16 female XLR and 4 female TRS connectors, a convenient handle on one end, and mounting holes so it can be secured to a wall or floor position.The XLR connectors have metal bodies with plastic sleeves and rubber strain relief boots. The 16 downstream connectors have white numbers (1‑16) and the upstream connectors have white letters (A‑D), making it easy to distinguish upstream and downstream connections.
